levels.title: SQL 1 · Grundlagen & saubere Formatierung
levels.concept_capsule: Nutze konsistente Einrückung, klare Namen und Standarddokumentation für sofort prüfbaren Code.
levels.starter_code: select id,email from users where active=1 order by id desc
levels.reference_solution:
-- Fetch active user accounts ordered by latest ID
SELECT
  id,
  email
FROM users
WHERE active = 1
ORDER BY id DESC;

levels.starter_code: select u.id,count(o.id) from users u left join orders o on u.id=o.user_id group by u.id
levels.reference_solution:
-- Count orders per user including users with zero orders
SELECT
  u.id,
  COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.id;
